evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Constantinopel: Constantinopolis
terms.comment: A town takes no preposition: Constantīnopolim (to), Constantīnopolī (at), Constantīnopolī (from). The name from the fourth century; the older Greek city was Bȳzantium.
The ancient Greek city on the Bosporus; Constantīnopolis is its later name, after Constantine (Lewis & Short).
